candidates.particulars: Grace Minseo Han is a 29-year-old American woman of Korean and Chinese Asian heritage. She lives alone in Seattle, Washington. Her gross household income is $128,000 per year, earned through her own work. She is single, not currently partnered, and has no children. She identifies as libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and expressing skepticism toward government restrictions in both social and economic life. She enjoys reading for leisure, especially contemporary fiction and essays.
candidates.life_course: Grace grew up in a family that moved between regions for her parents’ work and became comfortable making new routines in unfamiliar places. After college, she settled in the Pacific Northwest and built a career in digital product design. She rents a small apartment by herself and keeps close ties with relatives who live elsewhere; being single is a settled part of her life rather than a temporary project. Her work is mostly desk-based, with occasional collaborative stretches that make her appreciate quiet evenings.
candidates.daily_life: She starts weekdays with coffee and a walk, works regular office hours, and often cooks something simple at home. She keeps a few friendships through a book group and shared meals, but does not fill every weekend with plans. Reading is a dependable way to unwind, and she alternates novels with nonfiction she finds through friends or browsing. She likes having enough structure to meet commitments and enough open time to change her mind.
candidates.travel: Grace likes trips that combine a walkable city, good food, and access to nature, without requiring a packed itinerary. She can usually arrange a long weekend or use paid time off for a longer annual trip, and her income lets her save ahead while still weighing travel against rent and other priorities. She has traveled with a close friend to Vancouver, where they spent a relaxed few days wandering neighborhoods and taking a day trip outdoors. She also enjoys solo travel when she wants to set her own pace. A future trip might be domestic or international; she has not settled on one.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is observant and measured, and tends to ask practical questions before agreeing to a plan. She is warm with familiar people but not instantly confiding. In conversation she gives clear opinions, usually with a qualification when the subject is complicated, and dislikes being pressured to make decisions on someone else’s timetable.

candidates.particulars: Grace Minseo Han is a 36-year-old American woman of Indian Asian heritage. She lives in Portland, Oregon, and shares a rented home with a longtime platonic friend. Their combined gross household income is $156,000 per year. Grace is single, has no romantic partner, and has no children. She identifies as libertarian, valuing individual liberty and being skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. She enjoys reading for personal interest, particularly history, memoir, and novels.
candidates.life_course: Grace was raised in a close-knit family and remained connected to relatives even after leaving home for university. She trained in occupational therapy and now works in a rehabilitation setting, a career she chose because she likes practical, person-to-person work. Her housemate is a friend, not a partner; they share household costs and chores while maintaining separate schedules and private space. Grace has dated at different points but is content not to organize her life around finding a relationship or having children.
candidates.daily_life: Her workdays can be emotionally busy, so she prefers a quiet transition home: changing clothes, making dinner, and reading before bed. She sees a couple of friends regularly, sometimes for a meal or a low-key outing, and calls family on weekends. She likes cooking but does not treat it as an elaborate hobby. A neighborhood walk, library visit, or unplanned afternoon with a book feels as worthwhile to her as a large social event.
candidates.travel: Grace enjoys trips with a sense of place—markets, museums, local food, and time to notice ordinary life—rather than trying to see every major attraction. Her work schedule makes weeklong leave possible with advance coordination, while her shared household costs and savings habits give her room to travel without making every trip extravagant. She has taken a solo trip to New Orleans, choosing a modest guesthouse and spending much of the time walking, listening to music, and reading in cafés. She also likes visiting relatives, though those trips involve more family time and less spontaneity. She has no particular future destination booked.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is considerate but direct, especially when coordinating shared plans or boundaries. She listens closely and remembers details, yet can be quiet in a new group until she has a feel for it. She often describes herself as interested rather than adventurous: willing to try something unfamiliar, but not eager to turn a holiday into a test of endurance.

candidates.particulars: Grace Minseo Han is a 44-year-old American woman of Korean Asian heritage. She lives in San Jose, California, in a household with her widowed mother; their combined gross household income is $181,000 per year. Grace is single, has no partner, and has no children. She identifies as libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and remaining skeptical of government restrictions in both social and economic life. She enjoys reading for leisure, including literary fiction, biographies, and books about design and cities.
candidates.life_course: Grace studied engineering and moved into technical program management after several years in software quality work. She and her mother began sharing a home after her mother was widowed and wanted company; they value the arrangement while protecting each other’s independence. Grace contributes to household expenses and handles some errands, but does not regard herself as a substitute spouse or parent. Her work is stable and well paid, though deadlines can make some weeks long. She has had relationships in the past and is currently unattached by choice and circumstance.
candidates.daily_life: On workdays, Grace keeps a list of priorities and tries to finish the most demanding tasks before late afternoon. She and her mother usually eat together several evenings a week, and Grace reserves other nights for friends, reading, or simply being alone. She enjoys visiting museums and independent bookstores, and occasionally meets former colleagues for dinner. She reads in short stretches during the week and saves longer sessions for weekends. Family responsibilities shape her calendar, but she still protects time that belongs to her.
candidates.travel: Grace prefers trips with a comfortable base and a mix of planned activities and free time. She can afford occasional longer travel, but coordinating time away with her mother and work means she plans earlier than she once did. A memorable past choice was taking her mother to San Diego for a few days: Grace arranged a relaxed itinerary with meals together and time for each of them to do their own thing. She also enjoys traveling alone, particularly to cities where she can use public spaces, browse shops, and read between outings. She is open to future trips with family, friends, or solo, without having selected a destination.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is organized and steady under ordinary pressure, though she can become terse when too many people assume her time is automatically available. She has a dry, understated sense of humor and often thinks aloud before reaching a conclusion. She is affectionate with family but values privacy, and tends to prefer practical compromises over dramatic confrontations.

candidates.particulars: Grace Minseo Han is a 52-year-old American woman of Filipino Asian heritage. She lives alone in Anchorage, Alaska. Her gross household income is $116,000 per year, primarily from her own employment. She is single, not partnered, and has no children. She identifies as libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and skepticism toward government restrictions in both social and economic life. She enjoys reading for leisure, especially mysteries, travel writing, and narrative nonfiction.
candidates.life_course: Grace moved to Alaska in her thirties after several years working in logistics elsewhere in the United States. She now coordinates operations for a regional supply business, a role that involves careful planning and occasional schedule changes. She has lived alone for much of her adult life and has built a dependable circle of friends, including people from work and a local walking group. Her income is comfortable but she pays attention to savings and the higher costs of maintaining a home and traveling from her location. She has no children and is not seeking a partner as a condition of feeling settled.
candidates.daily_life: Grace checks messages and weather before leaving for work, then spends much of the day coordinating people and moving parts. After work she may cook, read, or meet a friend for dinner; weekends vary with the season and the energy she has left. She likes walking outdoors but does not insist on making every free day an expedition. She calls siblings and friends who live elsewhere, and keeps books within reach at home and during quieter breaks. A predictable routine matters, though she is accustomed to adjusting it when work requires.
candidates.travel: Grace values travel that gives her a change of pace and a vivid sense of the place, whether that means a few days in a city or time outdoors. She tends to take one longer trip when work allows and occasional shorter breaks, saving in advance because distance makes spontaneous travel less convenient. She once chose a road trip through parts of Alaska with a friend, keeping the route flexible and stopping when a landscape or small town caught their attention. She also visits family in the lower 48 and enjoys the contrast between those visits and independent vacations. She has not committed to a future destination or travel style.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is practical, self-reliant, and more comfortable with candid conversation than polite hints. She can be sociable when she has the energy, but she does not interpret a quiet evening alone as a problem to solve. Her humor is dry, her stories are detailed when she knows the listener is interested, and she prefers making her own choices without making a performance of independence.
